Avant-garde art-rock chamber folk, prime-limit lattice modal tuning with strict microtonal purity. Bitonal quartal suspension field over sustained kamancheh drone. Angular patter singing with yodel register flips, harsh consonantal nuclei, and guttural phonotactic distortion. Rhythmic co-prime cycle interlock 5:7:11 with gradual phase shift, micro-timing fluctuations, and 3:2 pulse coupling. DTMF touch-tones, shift-register noise channel, circuit-bent claviolin, subtractive synth bass, contact-mic table percussion, kanjira, and cuatro. Antiphonal choirs featuring hyper-articulated breath hocketing and group inhale triggers. Trashy cheap-spectacle delivery with obsessive fixative focus, erratic kinetic outbursts, and hyper-detailed structural juxtaposition, maintaining structural integrity across shifting metric planes.

caption: An avant-garde art-rock chamber folk collision of trashy theatrical spectacle and obsessive fixation. Built with prime-limit lattice microtonal tuning, co-prime cycle interlocks, antiphonal choir counterpoint, breath hocketing, and an eclectic palette featuring kamancheh, claviolin, DTMF tones, and shift-register noise. Tashlhiyt vowel starvation and consonant clustering deform the vocal line around the sovereign seed while maintaining strict structural and rhythmic physics throughout.
